name: precommit-gate
description: Gates git commit and git push run through Bash or PowerShell, using the pre-commit skill's check.js on every attempt: leaked secrets, secret files, bad commit messages and --no-verify are denied every time; warnings (a header over 50 characters, untracked files) stop the first attempt per staged change set. No declaration file. Fails open if the script is missing; denies are deliberate. Reads env: USERPROFILE, HOME.
